headline: MP Gazi Nazrul's second wife found dead at NAM Bhaban flat
summary: The body of 19-year-old Mariyam Khatun was found hanging from a ceiling fan in a flat in Dhaka.
details: The body of Mariyam Khatun, the second wife of Satkhira MP GM Nazrul Islam, was recovered from a flat in NAM Bhaban, Dhaka, on Sunday evening.
Police arrived at the scene around 7 PM after receiving a report and found the woman's body hanging from a ceiling fan in one of the rooms.
The Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Sher-e-Bangla Police Station confirmed the incident, though the immediate cause of death has not yet been determined.
Authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the death to uncover the details of the event.
MP GM Nazrul Islam has recently been the subject of controversy following a leaked hotel room video, which led to his expulsion from his own political party.
caption:
A 19-year-old woman, the second wife of a Member of Parliament, was found dead in a Dhaka flat.

The body of Mariyam Khatun, the second wife of Satkhira MP GM Nazrul Islam, was recovered from a flat in NAM Bhaban, Dhaka, on Sunday evening.

Police arrived at the scene around 7 PM after receiving a report and found the woman's body hanging from a ceiling fan in one of the rooms.

The Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Sher-e-Bangla Police Station confirmed the incident, though the immediate cause of death has not yet been determined.

Authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the death to uncover the details of the event.

MP GM Nazrul Islam has recently been the subject of controversy following a leaked hotel room video, which led to his expulsion from his own political party.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline: Fire breaks out at garment factory in Ashulia
summary: Four fire engines were dispatched to the Preeti Group factory in Jamgora, though traffic congestion delayed their arrival.
details: A fire broke out at a garment factory owned by the Preeti Group in the Jamgora area of Ashulia, Savar, this evening.
The Fire Service and Civil Defence headquarters reported that they received information about the blaze around 6:45 PM.
Four fire engines were dispatched to the scene to bring the fire under control.
However, wireless operator Md Jibon Mia noted that fire engines were delayed in reaching the factory due to heavy traffic congestion.
As of 7:45 PM, there have been no reports of casualties resulting from the fire.
caption:
A garment factory in Ashulia is on fire. Firefighters are battling traffic to reach the scene.

A fire broke out at a garment factory owned by the Preeti Group in the Jamgora area of Ashulia, Savar, this evening.

The Fire Service and Civil Defence headquarters reported that they received information about the blaze around 6:45 PM.

Four fire engines were dispatched to the scene to bring the fire under control.

However, wireless operator Md Jibon Mia noted that fire engines were delayed in reaching the factory due to heavy traffic congestion.

As of 7:45 PM, there have been no reports of casualties resulting from the fire.
